name: StrongTrendBar
longCondition: el_gt(close[lag], open[lag]) && el_ge(close[lag] - open[lag], bodyFraction * (high[lag] - low[lag])) && el_le(high[lag] - close[lag], tailFraction * (high[lag] - low[lag])) && el_le(open[lag] - low[lag], tailFraction * (high[lag] - low[lag]))
shortCondition: el_lt(close[lag], open[lag]) && el_ge(open[lag] - close[lag], bodyFraction * (high[lag] - low[lag])) && el_le(close[lag] - low[lag], tailFraction * (high[lag] - low[lag])) && el_le(high[lag] - open[lag], tailFraction * (high[lag] - low[lag]))
